title: Better Wood
description: This datapack increases the amount of items you get from crafting most building blocks to be more accurate with how much it should craft.
body:
This datapack increases the amount of items you get from crafting most building blocks to be more accurate with how much it should craft, plus a few extra recipes.

### New Recipes

A brand new way of crafting chests, using logs to get as much as you would get by using 24 planks! (Equivilant to 8 logs)

![New way of crafting chests](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/499e79d813e496d5e0bfe2bb69eda5c126446f52.png)

An easier way of crafting sticks with this recipe!

![More sticks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/293271fd668da4ddae6088e8c13ede570cc6d00d.png)

### More Items

These next recipes are how I feel vanilla recipes should be.
